---
name: Data error
about: A row in the dataset disagrees with the city's own document
title: 'Data error: '
labels: data-error
---

A report with all five fields below can be checked against the archived source
in minutes. A report missing them usually cannot be acted on at all.

**Meeting date**
<!-- The date of the meeting, as YYYY-MM-DD. -->

**Item number**
<!-- The agenda item number the clerk printed, such as 6B or 10A. If the row is
     a motion with no item, say so. -->

**What the source says**
<!-- Quote or describe the city's document: the minutes, the agenda, the vote
     panel. -->

**What the table says**
<!-- The row as you found it. Pasting the query you ran helps. -->

**Link to the source**
<!-- A URL to the city document. If it came from a PDF you downloaded, the page
     you downloaded it from is enough. -->
